howto.name: View the metadata
howto.text: PrivaTools displays the document's Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Producer, Creator, Creation Date and Modified Date, as stored in its Info dictionary, plus the page count.

howto.name: Decide what to do next
howto.text: To change the Title, Author, Subject or Keywords, switch to Edit in this tool; clearing a field removes it. To remove all metadata, use Strip Metadata.

faq.q: What metadata does a typical PDF carry?
faq.a: Usually: producer (the software that created it) and creation date. Often also: author name, original filename, software version. Scanned PDFs may carry scanner model + driver.

faq.q: Why does this matter for privacy?
faq.a: Producer + Creator + Author fields can identify the person or machine that created a document — useful in forensics, problematic for whistleblowers.
No. Only the Info dictionary (old format) is shown; the XMP stream (new format) is not read. When you edit, the new values are written to both.
